viewpoint: 第三人称运动相机跟拍视角

query.text: 请看着我跑步，有不规范的跑姿请帮我纠正，姿势改善时也请告诉我。
query.text_en: Please watch me run, correct improper running form, and tell me when my form improves.

annotation.text_zh: 跑步时收紧核心，骨盆保持中立，避免前倾。
annotation.text_en: Keep your core tight and pelvis neutral while running, and avoid leaning forward.

annotation.text_zh: 缩短步幅，尽量用脚掌中部着地，减少冲击。
annotation.text_en: Shorten your stride and land on your midfoot to reduce impact.

annotation.text_zh: 现在的姿势很好，身体自然前倾，核心很稳定。
annotation.text_en: Your posture looks great, leaning forward naturally with a stable core.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
